summary: Short stretch in dense trees at a junction; nowhere to stop.
reasons: No visible road surface to pull onto

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 11 m and 13 m away on both sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Line sits under canopy beside the junction, not on a visible lane; no clear stopping room.
drivers.traffic: Corner of a through street with parked cars on the main road.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the main road to the east, not here.

sun_shade: Heavy tree shade over the whole stretch.
cannot_judge: Whether the lane under the canopy is drivable
